name: Corner cobweb
description: A dusty grey orb web about 1 m across strung on a diagonal across a corner between two short stubs of dark crypt ashlar, about 1 m high, that meet in an L at the back: radial threads to the stubs and the floor, a loose spiral, a sagging top thread, a few broken drooping strands and clots of dust.

provenance.prompt: A dusty web strung across a corner between two short stone stubs, about 1 x 1 x 1 m.
